comments.body:
Final reward after you turn in the "World of Possibilities" quest (last quest in the Atlantis adventure chain)

Durability: 100
Formality: 30
Attack Power: 55
Defense Power: 30
Swordplay +2
Sword Mastery +2
Trap +1

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: It appears the quest "World of Possibilities" will give you this again if you managed to get the quest again via leeching someone. You can also get Cameo Habilite again though. So this is a farmable weapon.. somehow.
